name: Top Glove Corporation Bhd.
overview: 2026年，Top Glove Corporation Bhd. 未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项。公司公告主要涉及季度业绩、股息除权、公司秘书及委员会成员变动、附加上市（股份拆分）等企业事务。
overview_en: In 2026, Top Glove Corporation Bhd. did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract wins for its business segments in its announcements. The company's announcements mainly covered quarterly results, dividend ex-date, changes in company secretary and committee members, and additional listing (share subdivision) corporate matters.
